def get_key_name(path, headers):
    parsed = urlparse.urlparse(path)
    path_without_leading = parsed.path.lstrip('/')

        # path format /bucket/key
        parts = path_without_leading.split('/',1)
        return parts[1] if len(parts)>1 else ''
    else:
        # virtual-hosted style: host contains bucket, path is /key or possibly /
        # path_without_leading may start with key
        # split first component as bucket, rest as key
        parts = path_without_leading.split('/',1)
        return parts[1] if len(parts)>1 else ''
